buffer_size.label: Audio buffer size
buffer_size.description:
Controls how much audio is buffered in memory. A larger buffer improves playback stability and seeking but uses more memory.

- **Minimal**: Small buffer, recommended for memory-constrained devices.
- **Balanced**: Moderate buffer, good balance for most systems.
- **Maximum**: Large buffer, best performance for systems with plenty of memory.

allow_crossfade_same_album.label: Allow crossfade between tracks from the same album
allow_crossfade_same_album.description: Enabling this option allows for crossfading between tracks that are part of the same album.

stream_source_mode.label: Which source plays
stream_source_mode.description: How Music Assistant picks the copy to play when a track is available from more than one source, such as your own files and a streaming service.

option_descriptions.best_quality: Play the highest quality copy. An album plays all of its tracks from one source, and a playlist or folder plays from the source it comes from.
option_descriptions.prefer_local: Play from your local and self-hosted sources (files, Plex, Subsonic, ...) before streaming services, then pick the highest quality. An album plays all of its tracks from one source, and a playlist or folder plays from the source it comes from.
option_descriptions.best_quality_per_track: Pick the highest quality copy for every track on its own, even inside an album, playlist or folder.

upgrade_below_quality.label: Upgrade copies below
upgrade_below_quality.description: When the copy chosen by the setting above is below this quality, play a better copy if the track has one, and search your other streaming services once for a match.

smart_fades_log_level.label: Smart Fades Log level
smart_fades_log_level.description: Log level for the Smart Fades mixer and analyzer.

publish_ip.label: Published IP address
publish_ip.description:
This IP address is communicated to players where to find this server.
The default "auto" automatically selects the server's primary IP address at startup.
Set an explicit IP address if the auto-detected one cannot be reached by players on the local network (for example when running in Docker with bridged networking), otherwise audio streaming will not work.

volume_normalization_radio.label: Volume normalization method for radio streams

volume_normalization_fixed_gain_radio.label: Fixed/fallback gain adjustment for radio streams

background_scan_concurrency.label: Background analysis concurrency
background_scan_concurrency.description: Maximum number of tracks analyzed concurrently during the nightly background scan (1-16). Defaults to 1, or 2 on machines with 4 or more cores. Raise it for faster overnight scans at the cost of more CPU; analysis still never uses more than half the cores.

manifest.name: Streams
manifest.description: Configuration of the audio streaming and processing engine
